steps.text: To dictate text, place the cursor in an editable field.

steps.assertion: The focused field has a microphone.
steps.text: Choose the microphone or press **Alt+Shift+D**. Speak in French or English.

steps.assertion: A failed transcription offers Retry and Download.
steps.text: If transcription fails or takes too long, choose **Retry transcription** or **Download audio**. A recording saved locally can reappear under **Unused dictation** in the same browser and database. If browser storage is unavailable, download the audio before closing the tab.

steps.assertion: Odoo inserted the transcript in the selected field.
steps.text: Check the inserted text before saving or sending it. If you switched fields while waiting, choose **Copy transcript** and paste the text where it belongs.

steps.assertion: The chatter offers an internal note.
steps.text: To share an audio recording, open the record’s chatter. Choose **Log note** for internal readers or **Send message** to send it as a message.
Choose **Record a voice note**, the waveform icon, and speak.

steps.assertion: The draft has a playable voice note.
steps.text: Listen to the draft recording. If it is already attached to a saved draft, reopen that draft to send or remove it.

steps.assertion: The internal note is ready to post.
steps.text: When the recording is ready, post the note or send the message.

steps.assertion: The posted note contains the audio and the transcript.
steps.text: Readers with access can play the audio. Once processing finishes, they can read **Transcript** under the message. The transcription service receives the audio. The record and surrounding message stay in Odoo.

title: Dictate into a field or record a voice note
